text:
No fire was detected on this asset during the evaluated period (2026-09-23 to 2026-10-23). NASA FIRMS returned zero active-fire or thermal-anomaly detections whose footprint intersects ASSET-F01.

All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of the period. The absence of detections is therefore not explained by data gaps.

Some limits apply. Satellite detection is not a guarantee. Small, brief or cloud-obscured fires can be missed between overpasses. The data are near real time and may be revised. The asset's area isn't recorded in the run metadata, so I can't comment on how large the asset is relative to the sensors' pixel size.

In short, the evidence shows no satellite-detected fire on the asset in this period, but it doesn't rule out a very small or short-lived event.
